newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas -Switches in dollars and lire.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas -Switches in dollars and lire.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest Eurobond trade ideas featured Eurodollar, Eurolire and a cross-market switch between EIB bonds.
San Paolo expected EMU sentiment to weaken in the medium term although entry into the ERM should keep Italian assets supported for the next few weeks.
**Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters**
Sanwa International recommends this EuroFrench franc to Euromark switch:
STRATEGY The spread is at the upper-end of the six-month
range, with a low of one basis point and an average pick-up of 13 b.p.
STRATEGY This switch beats the curve by around 12 b.p.
and offers a pick up of about 22 b.p. along with an improved credit rating to AAA from AA1. The spread is at a six-month high with a 12 b.p average spread and a low of three b.p.
STRATEGY This switch beats the curve by about 14 b.p.
and offers a pick up of around 16 b.p. Again there is an improved credit rating to AA1 from AA3. The spread is at a three-month high with the average spread around eight b.p. and a low of two b.p.
STRATEGY This credit neutral trade offers a yield pickup
of around 40 b.p. while shortening duration.
STRATEGY Over the past month UBS has outperformed GEC by

approximately 85 b.p. in price terms. GEC is attractive against the swap and the BTP (trading respectively at six and seven b.p. through) and represents a 14 b.p. pick up in yield. Both bonds trade on a bid/offer spread of 50 b.p.
STRATEGY Deutsche Bank has underperformed other issues

in the same area by approximately 20 b.p. in price terms. Deutsche Bank is attractive as it offers good value against the swap (five b.p. through) and the BTP (18 b.p. through). It also trades on a bid/offer spread of 25 b.p.
